text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
New Year's Day. I went to pay our first 
shrine visit of the year together with 
Hishi Amazon.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Clap-clap!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
This year will be a decisive one for Hishi 
Amazon. I found myself wondering what she 
was praying for.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
All right, all done, all done! That line 
was longer than I thought, huh?
choice_data_list: What were you wishing for back there?
What were you wishing for earlier?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Well, obviously, for the continued 
good health of the people who matter most 
to me, just like always!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
What, you look surprised. Well, I can tell 
what you're trying to say.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"To be honest, I've got a huge race coming 
up this year. I did think about asking for 
some better luck in it."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Though well, praying to gods ain't really 
our style. Victory is something you and I 
grab with our own hands. Right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her characteristically bold answer brought 
an involuntary smile to my face.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
And so, what should we do after this? We 
could always just jump right into 
training.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Since it's New Year's, I wonder if we 
could do something traditionally festive.
choice_data_list:
Want to grab a bite from the food stalls 
before heading back?
Maybe I'll try a hidden talent or two

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Oh, sounds great! I was just starting to 
get hungry anyway.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, we browsed the festival stalls 
around the shrine grounds—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that was delicious! Grilled squid just 
tastes way better when you eat it outside!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Wait, Trainee-boy! Your hands are all 
sticky!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems she spilled food on herself while 
eating.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Good grief, you're hopeless. Here, I have 
some wet wipes, clean yourself up.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After that, the two of us strolled around 
for a while, enjoying a relaxing New 
Year's Day.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Huh, doesn't that sound fun! It's that 
thing, right? Where you pull the 
tablecloth and all?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Fuji's always freak—surprising me with her 
magic tricks, after all!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: I'll be the one to shut them up for once!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Tablecloth is set. Glasses and plates, all 
in place!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, I watched the footage, this'll be a 
piece of cake. I'll nail it on the first 
try!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: —Hup!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (—Crash-bang-wallop!)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Whaaa?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the end, that day was spent 
relentlessly practicing party tricks until 
complete satisfaction was reached.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's not a bad idea. It takes a bit 
of effort, but it's a great chance to show 
off some skill!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Now that that's settled, time to go 
shopping!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Take off the bamboo mat, and— yep, the 
datemaki turned out beautifully too!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Hey Trainy, how's that rolled kelp coming 
along on your side? Has the broth boiled 
down yet?"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Aaah, it's really starting to feel like 
New Year's.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
By dividing up the work, we managed to put 
together a truly delicious-looking spread 
of osechi cuisine.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
This is definitely the decisive year. I 
want to sprint through it at full power 
together with Hishi Amazon.
